rationale: source-monitoring: the dispatch-only check-sources call and inaccessible-source triage. In build mode the worker exits at its scrape-cadence gate having checked nothing; that exit is a run. One run is one firing of source-monitoring.yml. Registered so the workflow records its own run (CLAUDE.md rule 17) and the closure gate's NEVER-RUN check reads the ledger row; the artifact is emitted by scripts/lib/emit-workflow-run-artifact.mjs from the workflow's own record job.
